offering_description.value: Public Service Enterprise Group is a New Jersey energy holding company. Its regulated utility, PSE&G, delivers electricity and natural gas to residential, commercial and industrial customers. Its PSEG Power unit operates nuclear generation and sells the output into wholesale markets.

primary_products.value: electricity delivery; natural gas delivery; nuclear-generated electricity; wholesale electricity and capacity

primary_services.value: electric transmission and distribution; gas distribution; utility-run energy efficiency programs; solar and meter-related utility programs

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential electric and gas customers in New Jersey; B2B: commercial and industrial utility customers, wholesale power markets, energy suppliers

end_markets.value: electric utilities; natural gas utilities; wholesale power markets; residential and commercial energy

revenue_model.value: service fees: regulated rates for electricity and gas delivery; product sales: nuclear power sold into wholesale energy and capacity markets and under contracts

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs transmission and distribution networks and nuclear plants, sells to retail customers and the wholesale market

geography_served.value: US regional: New Jersey utility service territory, power sold in the PJM Interconnection region, mid-Atlantic and Northeast

specialization.value: related lines: regulated electric and gas delivery plus nuclear power generation

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: utility service billed directly to retail customers through wires and pipes; other: wholesale sales through PJM energy and capacity markets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rate-regulated utility under the NJ Board of Public Utilities and FERC, nuclear plants regulated by the NRC
